windows.command: cmake -S "${workspaceFolder}" -B "${workspaceFolder}\build" -DOPENTLV_BUILD_BENCHMARKS:BOOL=ON -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; cmake --build "${workspaceFolder}\build" --config Release --target benchmark-tlv; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; & "${workspaceFolder}\build\benchmarks\Release\benchmark-tlv.exe" --benchmark_repetitions=10 --benchmark_report_aggregates_only=true --benchmark_out="${workspaceFolder}\benchmarks\results\latest.json" --benchmark_out_format=json

python -m venv "${workspaceFolder}\build\benchmark-tools-venv"; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; & "${workspaceFolder}\build\benchmark-tools-venv\Scripts\python.exe" -m pip install --disable-pip-version-check -r "${workspaceFolder}\build\_deps\googlebenchmark-src\tools\requirements.txt"; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; & "${workspaceFolder}\build\benchmark-tools-venv\Scripts\python.exe" "${workspaceFolder}\build\_deps\googlebenchmark-src\tools\compare.py" --display_aggregates_only benchmarks "${workspaceFolder}\benchmarks\results\baseline.json" "${workspaceFolder}\benchmarks\results\latest.json"
